source_grounded_semantic_meaning: A combinatorial configuration formed from plexity, separability, and similarity; twenty categories (UPX, DPX, nine multiplex, nine duplex).
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Do not collapse morphology to the literal substring -aļ- or call any property 'set' unconditionally.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Uniplex, duplex, or multiplex embodiment of a referent; duplex includes unspecified similarity/separability in DPX.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Do not equate plexity to ordinary set cardinality in every context; components and perspective must be distinguished.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Similar, dissimilar, or fuzzy/indeterminate similarity across components in configurations where applicable.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Similarity is not necessarily strict mathematical equality; avoid using EQ as the sole gold oracle.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Separate, connected, or fused components, where morphology makes the factor applicable.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: A graph edge does not automatically imply fused identity; a path does not prove morphological connectedness.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Whether referents belong/function together by inherent grouping, shared purpose, complementary purpose, or unrelated/divergent purposes.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Co-occurrence/connectedness alone is not evidence of affiliation; semantic purpose must be represented.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Monadic, agglomerative, nomic, and abstract ways of framing a referent.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Monadic is not 'exactly one member'; nomic is not automatically a universally quantified claim.

ithkuil_category_or_root: Extension (DEL / PRX / ICP / ATV / GRA / DPL)
source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Whole/bounded, proximal portion, initial phase, final phase, gradual inception, or gradual termination of a referent.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Segmentative of predecessor Ithkuil is not a drop-in New Ithkuil Extension morpheme.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Normal versus representative/potential/counterfactual/imagined status of referent within intended framing.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Do not map RPV directly to FALSE, UNKNOWN, AMBIGUOUS or model probability.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Processual versus completive framing of events/processes.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: PRC/CPT linguistic version is not the curriculum version identifier.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Stative versus dynamic viewpoint of a referent.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Linguistic Function is not simply algebraic function application.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Existential, functional, representational, or amalgamative/systemic semantic context.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Distinguish contextual interpretation from truth label and from English gloss.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Zero, null and empty-set senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Absence of members is not epistemic UNKNOWN.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: One, unity and related singular senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Distinguish unity, singleton cardinality, and monadic perspective.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Three/trinary numerical senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Numeric examples should not assume existing broad-range counting mastery.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Addition/subtraction senses across the root's lexical specifications.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Do not identify the entire multi-stem root with just one operator.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Multiplication/division senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Current published arithmetic compiler contains MOD but not DIV; curriculum gate forbids teaching MOD first.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Counting/enumeration senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Count order, ordinal successor and set cardinality are separate competences.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Numbers, integers, rational-number-related senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Verify exact stem/specification semantics before claiming subtype equivalence.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Real, irrational and imaginary number related senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Do not mark as taught with only basic arithmetic evidence.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Variable, coefficient, constant senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Lexical stem/specification may distinguish precise mathematical roles.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Abstract object, structure, and operation senses across stems.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Avoid collapsing the three distinct stems into one catchall meaning.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Identity / identification / equivalence-related senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Lexicon §1.3; verify target stem/spec before licensing direct equality mappings.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Grammatical / morphological category and related descriptive senses.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: This is a metalinguistic lexeme, not the surface category affix.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Plexity grammatical category.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Distinct from actual morphology encoding plexity.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Similarity grammatical category.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Similarity does not reduce to exact EQ.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Separability grammatical category.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Extension grammatical category.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Essence grammatical category.
semantic_caution_or_dependencies: Representative is not FALSE.

source_grounded_semantic_meaning: Function grammatical category.
